title: Animal Den
description: A hollow beneath gnarled roots reveals an animal's lair. The musky smell is strong, but among the bones and bedding you spot coins and what looks like an old herb pouch. Claw marks on the entrance suggest the occupant is sizeable.

choices.label: Reach in carefully
choices.description: Risk a bite for the best loot.

outcomes.text: Your hand closes around cold coin and dried herbs. The den's occupant is out hunting — lucky you.
A massive badger lunges from the darkness! Its teeth sink into your forearm before you wrench free with the coin pouch.
You reach in too far and the whole burrow collapses. You dig out muddy but unharmed, clutching a few coins.

choices.label: Smoke the creature out
choices.description: Wait for it to flee, then search freely.

outcomes.text: The creature bolts into the undergrowth. You search at leisure and find a modest hoard.
Smoke billows out... and so does a furious bear. It swipes at your party before crashing into the forest.
The smoke triggers a nest of angry hornets. Everyone scatters, covered in welts!
Wisdom prevails. You back away as a low growl rumbles from within the den.
